defects.what: The spike is fully implemented but still sits in design/spike/ instead of being git mv'd to archived/ with its tracker link fixed, as the spike README's step 5 requires.
Page input types are named PrioritiesPageProps / DumpPageProps while the reference page uses ProjectsPageData and Board uses BoardData, leaving three naming schemes.
DumpFeedInit redeclares entries and nextCursor instead of extending the new DumpFeedPage type.
The Bad example still names PriorityMatrixPage, a component this change deleted.
Root class order 'flex h-full flex-col' differs from the 'flex flex-col h-full' used by DumpPage and PrioritiesPage.
toDumpPageProps hand-types the action result as {data} | {error: unknown} rather than deriving it from fetchDumpEntriesAction's return type.
